notes.title: NYIP now available on keyboard
notes.notes:
[p]Keyboard support is added to the game, along with tutorials for keyboard and gamepad. 
This was something that was partially supported in the previous versions, but since then, we have worked on adding full keyboard support for the game. There are still some things we need to figure out  :)

If anyone didn't have a gamepad to test the game out, now is the time![/p]

notes.title: NYIP Demo released now!
notes.notes: [p]Next Year in Prizren – Demo Out Now![/p][p]It’s finally here the first playable demo of NYIP![/p][p]This is the first souls-like game ever made about the Battle of Kosovo. The title, Next Year in Prizren, is more than a name it's a vow, a promise of return. For us, it’s a spark. A reason to dig into the stories we grew up with and bring them to life in a new way.[/p][p]The visual style takes cues from Diablo, dark, textured, raw, but the soul of the game is entirely our own. We're exploring our history through combat, myth, memory, and atmosphere.[/p][p]The demo was built over 9 intense months by a small indie team. Our first game, our first step :) It's around 10 minutes of gameplay, and while it's just a glimpse of what's to come, it's something we're incredibly proud of.[/p][p]We'd love to hear your feedback. Every comment, idea, or reaction helps us shape what comes next.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey!![/p]
